buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.

3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS & CONDITIONS (other than Service Legal Agreement) 11. . The AMC shall be on Comprehensive Maintenance Service basis including repair & replacement of any defective parts with spare parts free of cost with the same make as of the machines, supply of consumables i.e. Tone r, Drums, Fixing Film etc. and all the components on site during the contr act period so as to ensure photocopier machine remains all time in worki ng /functional and usable condition. Further, the spare parts & consumabl es etc. used in the repairs by the bidder shall be of the same quality/specifications as that of the spare parts & consumables being repl aced. 22. . Before commencing the contract, the firm be directed to deposit Perform ance Security, if any, as per GeM contract. 33. . All the photocopiers along with accessories, if any, shall be checked at le ast once in a Month and carry out the necessary repair, including replace ment of Toner, Drum & Spare parts to ensure that they remain in general good working condition. 44. . The repair works have to be carried out at the location of the equipment except in the exceptional circumstances where the equipment or any co mponent may be required to be taken out for repairs in workshop. In suc h case the standby arrangement shall have to be made by the Firm and i n no way the working of photocopier shall be held up for want of any stan dby arrangements. 55. . Firm shall maintain the record of the monthly visits (for repairs) and sign ature of the complainant be obtained for each visit separately. 66. . No payment shall be made in advance to the Firm. The payment shall be made to the Firm after completion/expiry of three months (quarterly basi s) subject to having receiving of satisfactory reports for the said period fr om the actual users and submits the pre-receipted bills of three months f or making the payment. 77. . Firm is directed to maintain monthly Inspection Report of each Photocopi er and submit the same as and when required by the Competent Authorit y. 88. . No extra payment would be made to vendor except the rates approved b y this department at the time of accepting the tender. 99. . During the contract period, if it is found that the services being provided are not satisfactory or not up to the mark or the parts/consumables being replaced are substandard or not as per the specifications Department will be at liberty to take action as it may deem appropriate including prematu re termination of contract. 1100.. The Department reserves the right to terminate the contract at any time before the expiry of the period covered under the contract without assign ing any reason thereof and without incurring any liability. 1111.. Complaints lodged in the forenoon shall be attended to either in the fore noon itself or latest by afternoon of the same day. Similarly, complaints l odged in the afternoon shall be attended to in the afternoon itself and lat

est by the following morning. In case of complaint being not attended to within time, the department shall be at liberty to deduct the amount of Rs. 200/- per day as penalty from the final bill. 1122.. In case of job work or material used is found below the standard and not according to the requisite specifications, the Department reserves the rig ht to forfeit the whole claim or part thereof. The decision of Department will be final in this regard. 1133.. The all conditions shall be accepted unconditionally. Non-compliance of the same would render the tender to be rejected outrightly. No request o f the bidder for amending or waiving or replacing any of the above terms & conditions shall be entertained. 1144.. The Firm should never have been blacklisted by any Govt./Semi Govt. De partment. If it is so discovered at any stage, Department may terminate t he contract pre-mature at any stage without assigning any reason and m ay also forfeit any claim or part thereof in its discretion. 1155.. Payment of salaries & wages of onsite Service Engineers required/deploy ment of Engineers (as per bid document) should be included in the bid pri ce/rate quoted by the firm. 1166.. The aforesaid contract shall be initially for two year, extendable upto six months at the discretion of the department on mutual consent with same rates and terms and conditions. 1177.. The rates quoted shall remain in force for a period of two years from the date of award of contract. No demand for revision of rate on any account shall be entertained during the contract period. 1188.. The firm should provide at least three dedicated telephone numbers for l odging the complaints over phone which shall remain open from 09:00 A M to 6:00 PM 1199.. The firm should submit certificate in the prescribed format as to the satis factory services being provided in respect of every photocopier duly sign ed by the Branch Incharge(s)/Reader of concerned Court/Branch. 2200.. The Technician/Engineer/workers visiting the Department shall always ca rry with them proper I-card duly signed /stamped by the Firm. 2211.. The department reserves the right to give further instructions/guidelines with regard to the services being provided by the firm at any time and it shall be its responsibility to carry out the same. 2222.. The firm shall not engage any sub-contractor or transfer the contract to a ny other Firm in any manner. This will be treated as breach of contract an d the contract shall be liable to be terminated forthwith. 2233.. It shall be responsibility of the firm to properly get the antecedents chec ked, of the technicians/ workers deployed for work. The firm shall be liabl e for their acts and keep this department indemnified for their acts. 2244.. Department may increase/decrease the quantity of Photocopier Machine s during the contract period on mutual consent basis on the same rates, t erms & conditions. The quantity may also be decreased if photocopiers ar e recommended for condemnation or on completion of condemnation pro cess. 2255.. The department shall remove/lesser the older/oldest photocopier machin es from the contract on receipt on new Photocopier Machines. 2266.. The waste parts/replaced parts, empty/waste consumables or spare part

s shall be removed by the firm at their end. 2277.. In case of any dispute with regard to contract order/bid, all the disputes s hall be subject to Delhi/New Delhi jurisdiction only. 28. 2289.. The firm should contact General Branch, West, Room No. 108, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi,for obtaining the details of Photocopier machines, place of installation before commencement of the contract. .
